requirements: Is there exactly one object visible?
Are both gate leaves swung toward the viewer and hanging at an angle from the posts?
Is the space between the two posts completely clear from post to post with no gate blocking it?
Is there no chain or padlock visible anywhere on the gate?
Is the riveted metal plate attached only to the left gate leaf?
Are the stone posts taller than a person and spanning about two people in width?
Is the entire object centered with a clear margin around it and fully inside the picture?
Is there a small soft contact shadow directly under the object?
Are the gate leaves open such that the gap between them is clear?
